steps.en: Install the CLI (archived at v3.16.1; existing installs only)
steps.zh: 安装 CLI（已归档，停在 v3.16.1，仅适用于已有安装）
steps.code: curl -fsSL https://byterover.dev/install.sh | sh · npm install -g byterover-cli

steps.en: Start it in your project and connect an LLM provider
steps.zh: 在项目里启动它，接一个 LLM 提供方

steps.en: Curate a fact, pointing at the code it is about
steps.zh: 整理一条事实，并指向它涉及的代码

steps.en: Its agent reads the code and files the knowledge into the project's context tree
steps.zh: 它的 agent 读代码，把这条知识归档进项目的上下文树

steps.en: Later, you or your coding agent ask about it
steps.zh: 之后你或你的编码 agent 来问

steps.en: Searches the context tree and answers from the curated knowledge
steps.zh: 检索上下文树，依据整理过的知识作答

value.en: Project knowledge survives across sessions and agents as reviewed, versioned files instead of being re-explained
value.zh: 项目知识以经过审核、带版本的文件跨会话、跨 agent 留存，不用再反复解释

sources: https://github.com/campfirein/byterover-cli README (main @ 1052ac1, archived; read 2026-10-08): Quick Start (install.sh, npm install -g byterover-cli, brv, /curate ... @src/middleware/auth.ts, /query How is authentication implemented?); CLI Usage (brv providers connect, brv review, brv vc, brv mcp)
